finding.summary: GitHub Actions default pull_request checkout supplied a synthetic two-parent merge commit to the Windows collector; the collector correctly refused it instead of accepting or guessing a parent.
finding.root_cause: The workflow ran the PowerShell collector tests in GitHub's default pull_request merge checkout even though the collector's explicit candidate invariant is one direct-child commit.
finding.repair: Retain default merge-result checkout for Linux unit tests, but pin the Windows collector lane to github.event.pull_request.head.sha (or github.sha for push) with complete history.
finding.nonclaim: This receipt does not rehabilitate the rejected 3743ad1 candidate, weaken the collector, or authorize activation, signing, nonce consumption, merge, deployment, release, or production use.
